vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2152: the skills-pack builder dispatch.ts::parseRouting still reads the removed '## Skill Routing' heading (removed by #838) and now yields an empty trigger map; re-source triggers from SKILL.md frontmatter / the REFERENCES.md Skills Index. Child of #1882; latent regression spun off from #838.

plan.title: parseRouting no longer depends on the removed AGENTS.md '## Skill Routing' heading

narratives.Description: #838 removed the '## Skill Routing' keyword->path table from AGENTS.md and the managed-section template, moving the routing index to the REFERENCES.md Skills Index. But dispatch.ts::parseRouting still parses the '## Skill Routing' heading to build its trigger map, so post-#838 it yields an EMPTY trigger map (latent coupling). This story re-sources the routing/trigger map from a durable source -- SKILL.md frontmatter (canonical, per-skill) and/or the REFERENCES.md Skills Index -- instead of the removed AGENTS.md heading, restoring a non-empty trigger map and decoupling routing data from the always-loaded policy file.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Locate dispatch.ts::parseRouting (packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts) and confirm the exact source it parses + the shape of the trigger map it returns, plus all callers. 2. Re-implement the trigger-map source: read triggers from each content/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter (the canonical per-skill trigger declaration) and/or the REFERENCES.md Skills Index table (built by #838). Prefer frontmatter as source of truth; fall back to the index if needed. 3. Preserve the existing return shape / behavior for callers; guarantee a non-empty map when skills exist. 4. Add/adjust tests: a regression test asserting parseRouting yields a non-empty trigger map covering the shipped skills, and does NOT depend on any '## Skill Routing' heading in AGENTS.md. 5. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry. Run `task check` green.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer relying on skill routing/dispatch, I want the trigger map sourced from SKILL.md frontmatter / the REFERENCES.md index rather than the removed AGENTS.md heading, so that routing keeps working after #838 and adding a skill does not require editing the policy file.

items.title: parseRouting yields a non-empty trigger map without the removed heading

narrative.Acceptance: Given #838 removed '## Skill Routing' from AGENTS.md, when parseRouting runs, then it returns a non-empty trigger map sourced from SKILL.md frontmatter / the REFERENCES.md Skills Index, covering the shipped skills.

items.title: No dependency on AGENTS.md '## Skill Routing' heading

narrative.Acceptance: Given the routing source, when AGENTS.md contains no '## Skill Routing' heading, then parseRouting still returns the full trigger map; a regression test asserts this.
Given `task check`, when it runs on the PR, then the new/updated tests and the full suite pass.

expected_outputs: parseRouting re-sourced from SKILL.md frontmatter / REFERENCES.md Skills Index; non-empty trigger map restored; regression test added

references.title: Issue #2152: parseRouting depends on removed Skill Routing heading
